title: Fantasy Island (1998 TV series)
premise_summary: Fantasy Island is an American fantasy drama television series, broadcast on ABC from September 26, 1998 to January 23, 1999, during the 1998–99 television season. A remake of the original Fantasy Island television series, it starred Malcolm McDowell as Mr. Roarke and was developed by Bob Josephson.
